narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Personal Anecdote -> Interjection/Cultural Contrast -> Shared Laugh/Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain the audience by sharing a humorous cultural observation about the difference between Northern (Taipei) and Southern Taiwanese social communication styles. It uses a specific anecdote about a dating misunderstanding to highlight how 'next time' can be interpreted literally by Southerners but as a polite ending by Northerners.
